name: source-links
title: Source section links
description: "§ Heading" references in source lines become links that open that heading of the page's online source.

urlField.description: Page field in site.json that holds the address of the page's online source.

baseUrl.description: Put in front of every relative sourceUrl, e.g. "https://example.org/handouts/".

marker.description: Text that starts a heading reference; everything after it (up to a separator) is the heading.

separators.description: Characters that separate several references in one line.

selectors.description: Simple selectors (tag, .class or tag.class) of the elements scanned. Only elements that contain plain text (no child tags) are changed.

textFragments.description: Add #:~:text=… so browsers scroll to and highlight the heading. "Start … End" in a reference becomes a range; quotes and (asides) are left out.

linkTitle.default: Open this section of the source
linkTitle.description: Tooltip on each link; empty = none.

newTab.description: Open the links in a new tab.

requireUrl.description: Make study.py check report pages that use the marker in a scanned element but have no address (off by default, since "§" is also common for plain section numbers).
